gameModes.name: Rush
gameModes.description:
Attack or defend the telegraphs. The attackers need to destroy the telegraphs to progress through enemy territory.
The defenders can use their telegraphs to call in powerful artillery strikes on enemies that have been spotted.
gameModes.body: The attackers need to destroy the telegraphs to progress through enemy territory. The defenders can use their telegraphs to call in powerful artillery strikes on enemies that have been spotted.

gameModes.name: Conquest
gameModes.description: Capture and hold the flags. Massive all-out war: Hold the majority of the flags and eliminate enemy troops to win.
gameModes.body: Massive all-out war: hold the majority of flags and eliminate enemy troops to win.

gameModes.name: TeamDeathMatch
gameModes.description: A battle for survival. The side with the most kills will be victorious.
gameModes.body: The side with the most kills will be victorious.

gameModes.name: Breakthrough
gameModes.description: Breakthrough or defend the sectors. An epic journey with battles from the Great War. Attackers need to capture the flags & break through the enemy lines held by the defenders.
gameModes.body: An epic journey with battles from the Great War. Attackers need to capture the flags & break through the enemy lines held by the defenders.

gameModes.name: Domination
gameModes.description: Capture and hold the flags. Intense infantry-focused action. Hold the majority of the flags and eliminate enemy troops to win.
gameModes.body: Intense infantry-focused action. Hold the majority of flags and eliminate enemy troops to win.

gameModes.name: Possession
gameModes.description: Retrieve and release pigeons. Find messenger pigeons and send messages to your supporting artillery to take out the enemies.
gameModes.body: Find messenger pigeons and send messages to your supporting artillery to take out the enemies.

gameModes.name: BreakthroughLarge
gameModes.description: Breakthrough or defend the sectors. An epic journey with battles from the Great War. Attackers need to capture the flags & break through the enemy lines held by the defenders.
gameModes.body: An epic journey with battles from the Great War. Attackers need to capture the flags & break through the enemy lines held by the defenders.

gameModes.name: TugOfWar
gameModes.description:
A symmetrical, head-on conflict where the contested frontline can move in both directions. Conquering a Flag Objective allows a team to advance closer to the enemy base.
Once a team loses the Flag Objective closest to their base, they will have to defend 2 Telegraph Posts inside their base. The game ends when one team has destroyed both enemy Telegraphs or when the time runs out.

gameModes.name: ZoneControl
gameModes.description: Recover airdropped supplies. A desperate fight for resources: Secure the majority of the supplies to win.
gameModes.body: A desperate fight for resources: Secure the majority of the supplies to win.

Misc.name: KILL CAM
Misc.description: The Kill Cam highlights the stats of the killer and shows his whereabouts.

Misc.name: HUD
Misc.description: Control visibility of basic HUD elements such as crosshairs, health & ammo, minimap, damage- and hit indicators. Suited for Hardcore type gameplay.

Misc.name: FRIENDLY FIRE
Misc.description: Friendly fire means you can injure or kill your team members.

Misc.name: REGENERATE HEALTH
Misc.description: After being injured, the player's health will regenerate when staying in cover.

Misc.name: 3D SPOTTING
Misc.description: Enable 3D player spotting.

Misc.name: MINIMAP SPOTTING
Misc.description: Spotted players will appear on the minimap.

Misc.name: ALWAYS FOG
Misc.description: Permanently enables fog on the Battlefield.

Misc.name: NAMETAGS
Misc.description: Player names will appear over their head.

Misc.name: VEHICLE 3P CAMERA
Misc.description: Allow players to use the third person camera view when using vehicles

Misc.name: ONLY SQUAD LEADER SPAWN
Misc.description: If enabled the squad leader will be the only valid squad spawn when playing in a squad.

Misc.name: BEHEMOTHS
Misc.description: Enable or disable Behemoths on the maps in the rotation (Operations and Conquest only).

Misc.name: RELOAD FULL MAGS
Misc.description: If set to YES you will replace the existing magazine with a new one, even if there are bullets left in the previous one.

Misc.name: MAP VOTING
Misc.description: Enable map voting in the EOR screen

Misc.name: DISABLE PRE-ROUND
Misc.description: Disable pre-round

Misc.name: AIM ASSIST AUTO ROTATION
Misc.description: Choose whether zooming in with your infantry weapon snaps to a nearby enemy target.

Misc.name: AIM ASSIST SLOWDOWN
Misc.description: Choose whether infantry weapon aim slows down when the reticle is over an enemy target.

Misc.name: LATENCY LOCK
Misc.description: Choose whether to use a cap on latency.

Misc.name: LENIENT LATENCY
Misc.description: If enabled will allow a larger latency to hit enemies without having to lead.

Misc.name: UNLIMITED MAGAZINES
Misc.description: Choose to enable unlimited magazine reloading.

Misc.name: DISABLE SPECTATOR DELAY
Misc.description: Remove the delay that spectators experience so that what is seen is happening as close to real-time as possible

Misc.name: DISABLE TEAM BALANCER
Misc.description: Disable team balancer so no players are moved automatically from one team to another

Scales.name: BULLET DAMAGE
Scales.description: The amount of damage each bullet does.

Scales.name: TICKET COUNT
Scales.description: Tickets decide how long the game is. More tickets means longer games.

Scales.name: RESPAWN TIME
Scales.description: The time it takes for a killed player to be able to deploy again.

Scales.name: VEHICLE RESPAWN TIME
Scales.description: The time it takes for a destroyed vehicle to be available again in the base.

Scales.name: ROUND TIME LIMIT
Scales.description: Round time limit applies a multiplier on the default time limits of games. A value of 0 will use the default time limit for Frontlines and place no time limits on all other game modes.

Weapons.name: MELEE
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Melee weapons.

Weapons.name: EXPLOSIVES
Weapons.description: Allow players to use explosives such as grenades.

Weapons.name: LMG
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Light Machine Guns.

Weapons.name: SMG
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Submachine Guns.

Weapons.name: SELF-LOADING RIFLES
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Self-Loading Rifles.

Weapons.name: SINGLE-ACTION RIFLES
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Single-Action Rifles.

Weapons.name: CLASS GADGETS
Weapons.description: Allow players to use class-specific gadgets.

Weapons.name: STANDARD ISSUE RIFLES
Weapons.description: Allow players to use Standard Issue Rifles.

Vehicles.name: LAND VEHICLES
Vehicles.description: Allow the use of Land Vehicles.

Vehicles.name: AIR VEHICLES
Vehicles.description: Allow the use of Air Vehicles.

Kits.name: ASSAULT
Kits.description: Allow players to select the Assault class.

Kits.name: MEDIC
Kits.description: Allow players to select the Medic class.

Kits.name: SUPPORT
Kits.description: Allow players to select the Support class

Kits.name: SCOUT
Kits.description: Allow players to select the Scout class

Kits.name: ELITE CLASSES
Kits.description: Allow players to use elite classes.

serverType.name: OFFICIAL
serverType.description: An official server allows awards, scores and unlocks to be applied towards players' career progressions. Players can join the server via Quick Match.

serverType.name: RANKED
serverType.description: A ranked server allows awards, scores and unlocks to be applied towards players' career progressions, but will not receive players from Quick Match.

serverType.name: PRIVATE
serverType.description: A private server is an unranked server that is password-protected.

serverType.name: UNRANKED
serverType.description: An unranked server does not allow awards, scores and unlocks to be applied towards players' career progressions.
